2609.05152.title: Compression Beyond the Uncompressed: A Two-Stage Training Recipe for Soft Context Compression in RAG
2609.05152.paper_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances language models with external knowledge, but the lengthy retrieved context inflates the input and degrades inference efficiency. Soft context compression encodes each document into a substantially shorter embedding sequence. However, most existing approaches are trained by distilling outputs from uncompressed RAG systems, inherently limiting their performance relative to the original model. To address this limitation, we propose DEX-Comp, a two-stage training recipe: Pure Distillation warm-starts the compression model on the uncompressed RAG's correct responses only, and Hard Exploration then runs reinforcement learning solely on queries the uncompressed RAG fails, forcing the model to explore computation patterns better suited to compressed representations. On five open-domain QA benchmarks at retrieval depths from top-5 to top-30, DEX-Comp compresses retrieved contexts by $16\times$ and accelerates inference by $4\times$--$24\times$, while achieving performance comparable to or exceeding the uncompressed RAG baseline across retrieval depths. Ablations and evaluations across diverse datasets and backbones further confirm the contribution of each stage and the generalization of our approach.
2609.05152.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）透過外部知識增強語言模型，但冗長的檢索上下文會膨脹輸入並降低推理效率。軟上下文壓縮將每個文檔編碼為顯著較短的嵌入序列。然而，大多數現有方法是通過從未壓縮的 RAG 系統中提煉輸出來訓練的，這在本質上限制了它們相對於原始模型的性能。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了 DEX-Comp，一種兩階段訓練方案：純蒸餾僅在未壓縮 RAG 的正確響應上啟動壓縮模型，而硬探索則僅對未壓縮 RAG 失敗的查詢進行強化學習，迫使模型探索更適合壓縮表示的計算模式。在五個開放領域的 QA 基準測試中，檢索深度從 top-5 到 top-30，DEX-Comp 將檢索的上下文壓縮了 $16\times$，並加速推理 $4\times$--$24\times$，同時在各檢索深度上達到與未壓縮 RAG 基準相當或超過的性能。各種數據集和骨幹的消融和評估進一步確認了每個階段的貢獻以及我們方法的泛化能力。
